title: Noor-i-Muhammadiyya, the Sacred Light
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadur
Rasoolullah. Alfu, alfu salaat, alfu, alfu salaam yaa Sultan al-Awliya. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Madad yaa Sultan al-Awliyaa. As-salaamu `alaykum yaa `ibaadullah, wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh.
Dastoor yaa RijaalAllah. Madad yaa Saahib al-Waqt, yaa Sayyidina wa `alaa aalihi wa saahbihi wa sallam.
Yaa Rabbee! O our Lord! Forgive us; we are looking to You, to Your blessings and we are saying, a`oodhu
billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem.
O Listeners! Give whole care for something you cannot find easily through east and west. This is a new
foundation that is open for servants of the Lord (swt) to protect them and to put them in safe way, here and
Hereafter. Therefore, say a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem.
Our sword, one heavenly sword may do more than whole swords through the hands of people. One is enough,
one heavenly sword. Billions of people are carrying swords in front of that One's sword and all of them should
fall down from the hands of people. Heavenly subjects most important subject on people. If you can reach
whole treasures on this world instead of one heavenly sword's power, it is zero. Zero cannot give anything to
people. Therefore, the Lord of Heavens ordered Sayyidina Adam (a), "Go down, because Shaytan will do for
you his worst and he has declared war against you and against your whole generation. Now I am throwing

that one on Earth and I am also ordering to you.” `Ajeeb, very strange meaning of understanding from Holy
Qur’an.
Why had Adam (a) been sent to Earth? Because Shaytan, did his worst for that one who Allah Almighty
created him to be khalif on Earth, and Shaytan was his most dangerous enemy. First, the Lord of Heavens
(swt) sending Shaytan, throwing him away from Paradise onto Earth. Allah Almighty ordering for a fight
among Adam (a) and Shaytan, but heavens was not war land, war field, so He first threw Iblees (Shaytan)
falling down and when he fell down he was rolling 99 times on Earth, because he had been sent out with
heavenly anger! “Down! Go from here!”
O our Salafi `ulamas! What is your understanding that first Shaytan had been thrown down to be on Earth?
Because Shaytan was declaring war against Adam (a) as Shaytan was looking to make Adam (a) not to be in
Paradise. In Paradise it was impossible to touch Adam (a) and his generation. So he went in with a trick,
making and entering. First of all, he was kicked down and then the Lord of Heavens ordering Adam, “You
and your wife go after Shaytan, that he will try to do his worst to you and to your generation. And I am the
Lord of Heavens, I am the Lord of whole Creation. I know what it is going to be! And what I said, wa
kalimutullahi hiya al-`ulya, "Allah's Word is the highest."
O Salafi `ulamas! •••••••••• •••••• •••• ••••••••••
wa kalimutullahi hiya al-`ulya, And Allah's Word, it is the highest.(9:40)
What does it mean? Say! I am asking; I know nothing, but you are claiming to know. What does it mean
kalimutullahi hiya al-`ulya? What Allah Almighty says and His command, must be the highest; not anyone
going to be after that. Allah Almighty's verse, He said, “Whole Creation, bow to Adam!" He was not saying,
"Bow to Me."
O Salafi `ulamas! Was Allah Almighty not seeing, not hearing, not asking? Was He absent when He ordered
every angel to make sajdah, to bow? He was looking like this? (Mawlana Shaykh looks to the side) or seeing?
He was ordering to bow to Adam (s). Why was He saying that? Because He was ordering tribute to Sayyidina
Adam (a) and He was saying, “My Word is going to be first and no one is going to be saying (otherwise), and I
ordered to make sajdah to Adam and I am looking." For what Allah Almighty was ordering angels to bow to

Adam?
O Salafi `ulamas! Listen here and then think on it. You know that when whole angels have just been ordered
to make sajdah, there must be some wisdoms, some secrets there. Allah Almighty never ordering angels to
make sajdah to Adam’s physical body. Yes? Allah Almighty ordering, haykal Adam! Angels going to make
sajdah. You think so? You are wrong. And if that secret is not going to be clear on Adam, Allah Almighty was
not ordering angels to make sajdah, because when He ordered to the angels, (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) He
was dressing on Sayyidina Adam noor al-Muhammadi (s) (Light of Muhammad)!! Sayyidina Muhammad (s)
from pre-Eternal to Eternal! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Angels are innocent ones, they are looking like statues, haykal Adam, statue, they are looking like this. When
Allah Almighty ordered this, He dressed from Muhammad's (s) lights (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits), and
angels cannot stand up, all of them bowing. Is it true, Salafi `ulamas? What are you saying? Angels just
knowing material being of Adam (a) or something else? Material being has no value, but when He ordered
angels to bow, just dressed him from His divinely lights and appearing on Sayyidina Muhammad (s)!
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Just appeared Haqqiqatu 'l- Muhammadiyyah, the real being of Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! And angels bowed without hesitating (Mawlana Shaykh bows); not only angels, but whole
heavenly beings and heavens falling to sajdah. Because wa lama tajalla rabbahu li-musa, fa lama tajalla
rabbahu lil-jabal kharra Musa. Understand, I am a weak servant, I am not claiming to know this or that, but
you are Salafi `ulamas.
When Allah Almighty just giving from His Divinely lights one ray, like jabal Musa, kharra Musa sa`iqan.
Allah Almighty saying that Moses, peace be upon him, is from the five big messengers, oolu 'l-aazam. Musa
(a) was asking Allah Almighty, “I like to see you.'” Allah (swt) saying, “Musa, you can't carry this, you can't
carry, but look at that huge mountain, what it is going to be.” No one was understanding the time that
reached to that huge mountain, it became only dust, and Sayyidina Musa was falling down.
Adam (a) was created and Allah Almighty was declaring to whole angels, because when objecting, Allah
Almighty informed them, "I am making My khalif, My deputy." Angels' understanding was not reaching what
the Lord of Heavens was asking for a new Creation. And ordering us to accept that one because he will be
highest through whole Creation. Whole Creation going to be for him, and whole Creation must know about

him, and whole Creation must know that he had been granted to be deputy through heavens!
There is no deputy for Allah Almighty through divinely levels, that kuntu kanzan makhfiyyan, levels of
Divinely Presence, saying, “I am an Unknown Treasure, and I asked My Divinely Will giving a way for a
Creation that people must know, that asking from Me, ‘Who is Allah?' for showing them something on their
understanding level. I said, only I am:
••• •••• ••••• •••••• •• •••• ••••• ••••• ••• ••••
kuntu kanzan makhfiyyan fa-ahbabtu an a`araf fa-khalaqta'l-khalq likay a`araf. "I was a Hidden Treasure
and I wanted to be known so I created creation and by it they knew Me."
Allah Almighty is continuously kanzan makhfiyyan, He is a Hidden Treasure, and what He is giving for His
Divinely Being no one knowing, and what He is giving for Creation.
Allah Almighty asking to show people and asking, "Who is our Lord, yaa Musa? Can we see Him? can we
know Him?”
(And Sayyidina Musa answered,) “O my Lord! You are speaking to me and I like to look to you.”
And Allah saying, "You can't, but I am asking My Divinely Will to appear on that huge mountain.”
Huge mountain, what is it, O Salafi `ulamas? It is jabal. That jabal has so many meanings, but jabal that
everything is in existence, if you are putting together. May be that huge mountain, huge heap, and sending
through a time that no one can be able to catch that time scale. Huuuu, going down. Sayyidina Musa (a) also
falling down to sajdah and saying, “O my Lord, I am asking for forgiveness, that I asked something which is
not for me.”
Coming O Salafi `ulamas, the day that Allah Almighty ordering angels, “Make sajdah, bow to Adam.” And
with his simple material being, it is not suitable to be bowed. No! Never! And he ordered angels, just putting
on Adam (a) his heavenly appearance; may be billions or trillions or quadrillions times small, coming on
Adam (a). Huuuuuu and angels running to sajdah, bowing to Adam. What about Shaytan? He was looking at
the material being of Adam (a) and saying, “You created Adam from mud and You created me from fire."
That was his deepest level of understanding of himself and of Sayyidina Adam (a); he was asking to change

his fire for lights. When a lamp lightening coming on Sayyidina Muhammad (s), when angels had been
created from lightnings from heavens, they ran quickly to sajdah. Therefore, don’t think that sajdah is going
to be done by the whole Creation, no. When Allah Almighty dresses that one in his heavenly dress, and
appearing from heavenly levels lightening, that makes people to bow. That makes whole angels to bow to
Adam (a).
Bow, tahleem, this is very important, very fine and endless understanding for it. Every Creation may
understand something, but reaching to that point. Why is Allah Almighty ordering angels to bow to Adam?
Not to Adam, when he dresses from his heavenly dress and angels then appeared. From heavenly lights that
belongs to divinely lights, angels were falling down, not being able to stand from sajdah. Heavenly lights, he
can't distinguish from what had been created and from the secret from the Seal of Prophets (s), Habeebullah,
most glorified one. Therefore, we are coming on a most important point, that if Salafi `ulamas are throwing
away from their hearts ghadab, anger, and hasad, jealousy.
Shaytan’s heart was full with those bad attributes that made him to look and to see, “That is Adam, whom
You created, and now You are saying to all of us to make sajdah, to bow to him! I was just filling whole
heavenly levels with worshipping and I would like instead of Adam, for me to be on that point." He was
looking, not looking to Adam (a) to differentiate between himself and Adam (a). Therefore saying, “You
created Adam from earth and You created me from fire.” And he was saying, “I was best or special of
creatures to be in that divinely honor, I was thinking it was to be for me, and You are giving to Adam? I am
not accepting!” When this happened, Iblees, Shaytan saying, “I am declaring war against Adam and his
generation!” Then Allah Almighty ordering, "Get out! Get out!" and he was out from Paradise and Adam (a)
remained in Paradise. Allah Almighty just saying, “That was My grant to you, O Adam, that there should be
for you here everything except one point: I do not want you to ask anything from that tree.”
And I would like to speak on it; perhaps they will give for another association.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah

Dome dome dome dome 8x
Fatihah.
As-salaamu `alaykum.
(46 minutes, 533 viewers)
Alhamdulillah, Allah Allah, yaa Huu. O Allah, forgive us and blessings you. We know nothing, He knows.
What we are saying, what Friends of Allah (swt) sending us to say and to speak and to address, through such
a speeches so many things suitable for our material being and also spiritual being.
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks with Shaykh Hisham and Hajjah Naziha on the phone.)
